_notes: Vulgate Ps 22→思高 Ps 23; Ps 23→24; Ps 24→25; Ps 25→26; Ps 26→27. Verse labels kept as Vulgate numbers per breviary convention. Ps 22:5 is split across two half-verses in the breviary; the second half-verse (Impinguásti…) repeats the傅油 clause as its first half and treats the cup as its second half — this diverges slightly from 思高 verse 5 which reads both clauses together; I split accordingly. Ps 22:6a (Et misericórdia…) ends with a trailing * as a mediant-only line with no following Chinese on the right side; rendered accordingly. Ps 23:6 思高 has 苗裔 (苗 not 苖 as the fetch showed; standard character used). Ps 24:1 — 思高 verse 1 has two parts combined; first half-verse gets first clause, second half-verse gets second+third clause. Ps 24:4 (Confundántur…supervácue) — in 思高 this is folded into verse 3 wording; rendered from sense. Ps 24:17 思高 has a combined verse structure; split across two lines. Ps 26:5 — 思高 verse 5 says '将我藏在他帐幕的深处，并将我高举放于磐石'；the breviary splits this over vv.5–6 at the 'in petra' phrase, so 26:6a begins with the 磐石 clause.
